mapper.select: SELECT ct1.CUNT_A = ct2.CUNT_B AS PAPER_STATE FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.`ADD_USERID`) AS CUNT_A FROM `inspection`.`inspection_working_paper` a WHERE a.`TASK_ID` = #{params.TASK_ID} AND a.`ADD_USERID` IN (SELECT a.`ADD_USERID` FROM `inspection`.`inspection_question_ledger` a WHERE a.`TASK_ID` = #{params.TASK_ID} GROUP BY a.`ADD_USERID`)) ct1, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.`ADD_USERID`) AS CUNT_B FROM `inspection`.`inspection_question_ledger` a WHERE a.`TASK_ID` = #{params.TASK_ID}) ct2
SELECT a.TEMP_PROC_NAME FROM `inspection`.`inspection_task_template` a WHERE a.TEMP_PROC_ID = #{params.PROC_ID}

SELECT SUM(a.`INSPECTION_PROCESS_SUB_SIGN`) AS SUB_PROC_STATE FROM `inspection`.`inspection_process_sub` a WHERE a.`INSPECTION_TASK_ID` = #{params.TASK_ID} AND a.`INSPECTION_PROCESS_SUB_ID` LIKE CONCAT(SUBSTR(#{params.PROC_ID}, 1, 5), '%')
mapper.update: UPDATE `inspection`.`inspection_process` a SET a.`IS_ACTIVE` = '0' WHERE a.`INSPECTION_TASK_ID` = #{params.TASK_ID} AND a.INSPECTION_PROCESS_SIGN = '1' AND a.`INSPECTION_PROCESS_ID` LIKE ( SELECT CONCAT(SUBSTR(a.`FOLLOW`, 1, 5), '%') FROM `inspection`.`inspection_task_template` a WHERE a.`TEMP_PROC_ID` = #{params.PROC_ID} )

UPDATE `inspection`.`inspection_process_sub` a SET a.`IS_ACTIVE` = '0' WHERE a.`INSPECTION_TASK_ID` = #{params.TASK_ID} AND a.INSPECTION_PROCESS_SUB_SIGN = '1' AND a.INSPECTION_PROCESS_SUB_ID LIKE ( SELECT CONCAT(a.`FOLLOW`, '%') FROM `inspection`.`inspection_task_template` a WHERE a.`TEMP_PROC_ID` = #{params.PROC_ID} )

UPDATE `inspection`.`inspection_process_sub` a SET a.`IS_ACTIVE` = '0' WHERE a.`INSPECTION_TASK_ID` = #{params.TASK_ID} AND a.INSPECTION_PROCESS_SUB_ID LIKE CONCAT(SUBSTR(#{params.PROC_SUB_ID}, 1, 5), '%')

UPDATE `inspection`.`inspection_process_sub_postsv` a SET a.`IS_ACTIVE` = '0' WHERE a.`INSPECTION_TASK_ID` = #{params.TASK_ID} AND a.INSPECTION_PROCESS_SUB_SIGN = '1' AND a.INSPECTION_PROCESS_SUB_ID LIKE CONCAT(SUBSTR(#{params.PROC_SUB_ID}, 1, 5), '%')
